mods.name: Faded Java Loader Bridge
mods.description: Optional FJL multiplayer compatibility bridge with client/server plugin hash verification, CSR Test identity aliasing, and Kahlua-safe FadedStack 1.1.1 lazy scheduling plus owner-keyed client/server command buses for Project Zomboid 42.20.3/42.20.4.

mods.name: Common Sense Reborn (Test)
mods.description: Build 42.20.4 private CSR test identity. Version 1.9.67 keeps the 1.9.66 authorized donor integrations and adds the Production gate-flash and headlight repair. Faded Java Loader is optional; Staircast and multiplayer ragdolls activate only when it is installed. 681 sandbox options. SP + MP.

mods.name: Faded's ClearView UI
mods.description: Faded ergonomic UI suite for Project Zomboid Build 42.20. Version 0.6.15 adds a public presentation-only external sidebar-control contract so CSR's exact Utility launcher participates in ClearView ordering, chrome, and auto-hide while retaining its callbacks and standalone fallback in either load order.

mods.name: CSR Clearview GPS
mods.description: Version 1.1.3. Standalone B42.20 Clearview-styled GPS with a movable right-side launcher, persistent local UI layout, movable/resizable GPS window, purple route rendering, server-authoritative route graph sync for MP, and singleplayer cache support.

mods.name: Tactical Operations Center
mods.description: A server-authoritative admin and player operations suite for Project Zomboid Build 42.20.4. Includes a full Command Center replacement, Covert Event social deduction, location reports, a true owning-mod-tabbed Item Spawn browser with fixed controls and contained list scrolling, mod-aware Operator and Blueprint tools, CSR authority handoff, FTN trade intelligence, mission routing, Echoes conflict monitoring, scalable 4K UI, and optional FJL/OpenCL dispatch acceleration with Lua fallback.

mods.name: Character Creator
mods.description: Character creation overhaul for Build 42.20.4: prebuilt playable characters with their own stats, perks and movesets, fully themed identity and wardrobe workspaces, complete occupation/trait/appearance presets, faces and body details, hair gallery, saved-survivor bios with 3D previews, starting loadout and vehicle pickers, exact-slot equipment sorting, budgeted loot, and a pack API for add-ons.

mods.name: Faded's Error Detected
mods.description: Build 42.20.4 diagnostics with ring-safe error capture, evidence-only attribution, a searchable ClearView-styled report interface, scalable detective alerts, persistent visibility controls, and installer update visibility. Its optional passive FJL performance profiler remains server-only and version-gated.

mods.name: Knox Transit
mods.description: Server-authoritative Build 42 transit stops integrated with Faded Trade Network.

mods.name: Faded's Legacy Codex
mods.description: Preserve hard-earned survival knowledge in physical Codexes and Compendiums for Build 42. Copyright (c) 2026 Faded. All rights reserved; do not copy, reuse, redistribute, or modify this mod's code without written permission.

mods.name: MP ChronoController
mods.description: Build 42.20.2 server-authoritative multiplayer Pause, Play, fast-forward voting, administrator override, sleep acceleration, safety recovery, and ClearView-style clock controls.

mods.name: ISyncYouSyncWeAllSyncForDeSync
mods.description: Build 42.20.2-42.20.4 low-overhead multiplayer diagnostics, visual smoothing, and exact-build selective server authority for driving, hordes, and combat. SP + MP.

mods.name: KnoxNet OS
mods.description: Build 42.20 networked computer OS with a borderless desktop, managed app windows, secure terminal sessions, multi-floor storage logistics, server-authoritative CCTV and alarms, optional What A World weather reports, renewable-power and WEX telemetry, printing, banking, medical records, and survivor services.

mods.name: Faded Trade Network
mods.description: Server-authoritative economy, multi-shop commerce, property ownership and leasing, Faction IDs and treasury finance, wealth rankings, and KnoxNet cash integration for Build 42.20 stable. Requires Common Sense Reborn or Common Sense Reborn (Test). Copyright (c) 2026 Faded / Faded Trade Network. All rights reserved; no reupload, redistribution, modpack bundling, forks, or modified releases without written permission.

mods.name: Buildcraft Reborn
mods.description: Build 42.20.2/42.20.3/42.20.4 Craft / Build / Projects workspace. Version 0.6.0 integrates eighteen authorized workshop packages as Buildcraft-native content: home zones, construction and glass crafts, supply/bulk tools, concrete mixers, incinerators, raisable bridges, VHS racks, fitted sheets, doorway curtains, item merging, and saved 3D placements. No required dependencies; the FJL accelerator remains optional.

mods.name: Faded Origins - Occupations & Traits
mods.description: Dark-edged occupations and traits with server-authoritative Resolve progression for Build 42.20.2. Integrates with SOTO and Old World Criminals.

mods.name: Knox Reborn
mods.description: Knox Reborn hybrid map mod for B42.20.4. Version 0.3.17 keeps the PZF map style and 0.3.16 map cooperation while repairing stale multi-floor cutaways after stair travel. It also reduces recurring client lighting work and adds optional Java floor-transition cache acceleration without changing maps, saves, multiplayer authority, or player graphics settings. Lua fallback remains fully playable without FJL.

mods.name: Echoes of Humanity
mods.description: Native Java NPC framework for Project Zomboid Build 42.20.4, loaded by Faded's Java Loader. Version 0.2.0 Living World adds 66 discoverable and claimable resource outposts, persistent provisions, defenses, and intelligence, signed field notes from existing survivors, a ClearView-compatible journal and territory-map pins, bounded solo and two-person ambient road journeys using the native vehicle controller, and optional Faded Field Operations, Faded Origins, and helper ownership integrations while preserving server authority, existing NPC identities, save persistence, and bounded work budgets.

mods.name: The Young Died Too
mods.description: Lightweight B42.20 adolescent zombies of varied heights. Schools, homes, parks and streets get age-appropriate youth among the dead. No Realism dependency. Population-neutral native IsoZombie conversions.

mods.name: Faded's The Hive
mods.description: The Long Hunt: a server-authoritative zombie ecology for B42.20.4. Version 2.2.0 restores climber and breacher traversal, adds landmark Strongholds, corridor-preferring wander, and a Chorus Scanner/Relay intel layer. The optional Java accelerator remains optional; Echoes of Humanity and My Only Friend are optional peers.

mods.name: The Big Tree Fix
mods.description: Fixes Build 42.20+ jumbo tree visibility indoors, while driving, and on foot. Registered fade canopies are save-loadable, and default-on infrastructure filtering downsizes selected XL/XXL trees near roads and buildings while preserving giant trees in dense forests. Fade textures based on work by movinow.

mods.name: Water Expanded
mods.description: The comprehensive Build 42 water, plumbing, irrigation and fuel-network overhaul. One server-authoritative WEX graph connects pumps, valves, meters, seep channels, building-wide liquid plumbing, storage, fixtures, gas stations and generators without a bridge hub. Includes calibrated rain collectors, liquid-effect details, mains reconnection, physical petrol routing, portable pumping, quick view, public physical-container API, optional Faded Java Loader acceleration and command routing, and a complete standalone native fallback.

mods.name: Solar Never Faded
mods.description: Authoritative Build 42.20 power and resilience suite: solar, wind, hydro, petrol/propane backup, pooled storage, EV charging, circuits, fences, streetlights, outages, water, portable power, three-panel command UI, CSR integration, and KnoxNetOS API.

mods.name: Temp Control
mods.description: Server-authoritative indoor air conditioning, heating, thermostat controls, schedules, timers, and power monitoring for Build 42.

mods.name: Faded Skies
mods.description: Standalone Build 42.20 helicopter flight, utility, and combat systems. Includes the FS UH-1B Iroquois utility helicopter and FS AH-64A attack helicopter. Designed for single-player, hosted multiplayer, and dedicated servers with server-authoritative weapons and noise.

mods.name: RVsReborn
mods.description: A cohesive Build 42.20 RV and Faded Locomotion interior system. Version 0.2.10 hardens multiplayer enter/exit authority with server-owned anchors, nonce-bound acknowledgements, durable vehicle identity migration, moved-RV resolution, and an optional native Faded Java Loader teleport bridge while retaining a standalone Lua fallback.

mods.name: Faded Locomotion
mods.description: A comprehensive Build 42 rail system with multiple trains, detachable rolling stock, bidirectional routes, multiplayer track authority, claims integration, and RV-compatible passenger cars. Version 1.0.0 repairs consist rendering, coupler spacing, turn alignment, carrier scale, force-position synchronization, and first-notch braking, with an optional Faded Java Loader carrier-pinning bridge and a complete pure-Lua fallback.

mods.name: On The Move
mods.description: Quiet human-powered mobility for Build 42.20: bicycles, skateboards, scooters, and rollerblades with rare sensible spawns, crafting, repairs, terrain response, riding exertion, and multiplayer animation synchronization.

mods.name: Tsar's Common Library
mods.description: Build 42.20.4-compatible common vehicle library required by Project Faded Car's licensed W900 truck and trailer runtime. Version 3.30 includes the current multiplayer VirtualVehicle fixes.

mods.name: Into The River
mods.description: Standalone Build 42.20.2+ river survival with integrated boats, optional RV interiors, offshore vessel travel, swimming, crafting, marine loot, and dedicated controls.

mods.name: Project Faded Car
mods.description: Project Zomboid B42.20.4 self-contained vehicle workshop. Version 2.3.2 permanently repairs all local vehicle-aim animation parent paths and adds a regression gate, while retaining the 2.3.1 tile-definition repair and the complete car-lift, yard, recovery, engine-bay, carrier, heavy-fleet, diesel, corpse-plow, and breakable-barricade systems. The FJL carrier and hoist plugin remains optional with Lua fallback and no external TsarLib dependency.

mods.name: Massive KI5 Pack
mods.description: Comprehensive performance-focused vehicle pack for Project Zomboid Build 42.20.2 through 42.20.4. Version 1.2.12 prevents gas tanks, water tanks, and tire-air components from being treated as item-storage containers and safely repairs vehicles contaminated by the previous audit without losing cargo; all prior 1.2.11 fixes remain intact across all 532 vehicles.

mods.name: Massive Vehicle Pack
mods.description: Standalone Build 42.20 vehicle integration pack with a public MVP API and optional RVsReborn interoperability.

mods.name: Faded Vehicles Reborn
mods.description: Build 42.20 MP-centric vehicle lifecycle mod with server-authoritative replacement tickets, B42 timed-action complete hooks, safe spawn scans, admin controls, and CSR compatibility.

mods.name: Military Vehicles Reborn
mods.description: Independent Build 42.20 military vehicle pack by Faded with repaired B42 mechanic-part resolution, visible roofs/turrets/modules, corrected military-truck grounding, and sharper UV-safe material detail. Includes M998M2 Humvees, M1A1 Abrams, M2 Bradley IFV, MRAP variants, and a military cargo truck.

mods.name: Chaded Military Convoy
mods.description: Version 2.2.0 for B42.20.2: consolidated Papa_Chad military convoy with the finished M4A1 Sherman Drive-and-Shoot, a UV-safe visual upgrade, and the rare purple/charcoal M998 Faded variant. Military-zone spawns only. Requires Faded's Military Tool Kit Fix 2.3.1 or newer (id Military_Tool_Kit).

mods.name: Faded's Ride or Rot
mods.description: Build 42.20 vehicle utility overhaul: rideable vanilla pickup beds, MP-conscious in-vehicle towing, and fast mechanics QoL. Soft-compatible with CSR, MVP, MVR, and RVs Reborn (no hard requires). Load after other Base PickUpTruck script overhauls.

mods.name: Faded's Advanced Medical
mods.description: FAM 2.2.1 for Build 42.20.2+: clinic circulation, pharmacology, lab stations, field forage, IFAK/scrubs, and upper-arm sockets inside FAM triage. Fixes fatal duplicate translation keys.

mods.name: Faded Farming & Fishing Reborn
mods.description: Unified B42.20.4 farming and fishing expansion with repaired brewing/distillation, home brewing, server-authoritative carts and wheelbarrows, cart-assisted furniture moving, expanded fish, legendary catches, taxidermy, seated fishing, and ClearView-compatible interfaces.

mods.name: Just2Faded
mods.description: Just2Faded for Project Zomboid Build 42.20. Fully standalone narcotics / crafting / farming pack with bundled Just Drugs content and built-in moodle UI.

mods.name: JustFaded: Tactical Faded
mods.description: A self-contained tactical Faded outfit for Project Zomboid Build 42.20.3. The Lynx long-sleeve shirt and full-protection carrier, Hound tactical helmet, cargo uniform, ArmorPK leg armor, attachment-ready vest, and field pack use a coherent gunmetal and deep-purple palette without external runtime dependencies.

mods.name: Parent's Journal
mods.description: A keepsake from home. Every survivor starts with Dad's Journal or Mom's Journal. Use it once to answer a few questions about your parent and receive bonus skill experience and personality traits based on your choices. The journal is consumed after you submit your answers.

mods.name: Salvaged Fuel Recovery Station
mods.description: Commission a fixed industrial generator and nearby tanks or barrels to manufacture and store gasoline or propane. Gasoline requires a hose and compatible container to recover; propane requires an empty propane tank.

mods.name: Faded's Afflictions
mods.description: Server-admin controlled hidden persistent afflictions for Project Zomboid Build 42. Includes an admin GUI, local hallucination-style audio, SCP-650-style phantom figures, artifact overlays, darkness, cold spots, panic/stress events, chat commands, and a cure item. Some audio/item/model asset references are reused with permission from [B42] They Are Watching - Schizophrenia Mod by Twuben and SCP-650 by BitBraven; see README.md and CREDITS.md.

mods.name: My Only Friend
mods.description: Server-authoritative dog and cat companions with 56 expanded visual variants, training, working orders, combat, rosters, wildlife ecology, persistence, and recovery. Version 2.3.6 keeps wildlife enabled while reducing new wolf grounds to five with 500-tile spacing, safely retires surplus or clustered wild grounds and stale markers, and never retires owned companions. Optional FJL adds engine AI control and bounded acceleration.

mods.name: Never Survive Alone
mods.description: Server-validated, explicit-opt-in adult intimacy for Project Zomboid Build 42.20. Version 0.6.0-alpha merges True HottieZ, Hottie-Z collectible posters, and Dildos! Redux into the Desire and scene-bonus system, and hardens Build 42.20.4 dedicated-MP scene freeze, wardrobe, and AntiCheatSpeed handling. MP-ready, with Common Sense Reborn Survivor Bond sync.

mods.name: Never Forget: Athena
mods.description: A small, respectful tribute to Athena. Admin-spawned, placeable, and made to hold a few warm moments of remembrance.

mods.name: Save The Babies
mods.description: Build 42.20.2 SP/MP baby care system with server-authoritative persistence, care GUI, crying, progression, FTN/FAM soft integrations, grief consequences, items, and admin recovery tools.

mods.name: The Last Testament
mods.description: Collectible Bible-inspired booklets with a custom parchment reading window and modest spiritual comfort effects.

mods.name: Faiths & Traditions: Miracles of the End
mods.description: Adds belief traits, faith books, progression, rituals, server-owned ultimate miracles, Bound Dead, Dead Veil, and a faith status panel. Includes optional shared command routing with an automatic standalone native fallback.

mods.name: Faded's Hunters Calling
mods.description: A comprehensive Build 42.20.2-42.20.4 hunting system with a responsive three-pane fieldbook, wild boar sounders, game feeders, a hunting tripod, wind-aware scent, a charcoal smokehouse and game cellar, five .308 rifles, four bows, native Crafting and Building tabs, tracking with an optional Java accelerator and complete Lua fallback, field dressing, preservation, calls, scents, trapping, and multiplayer-safe administration. Includes CraftBench leather/plant racks and a kiln rack for dedicated MP, where vanilla drying racks do not finish.

mods.name: The Price We Pay
mods.description: Build 42.20 server-authoritative SP/MP arrest, restraint, escort, and prisoner transport mod.

mods.name: Skill Book Expansion
mods.description: Adds the missing Build 42.20.2 skill books and book sets for Axe, Long Blunt, Short Blunt, Short Blade, Spear, Nimble, Sprinting, Sneaking, Lightfooted, Fitness, and Strength.

mods.name: Lifestyle: Hobbies (All-in-One B42.20)
mods.description: Lifestyle: Hobbies Author: [Angry] Are you looking to add more variety and depth to your survival experience in Project Zomboid? *Lifestyle: Hobbies* introduces a range of new interactions and activities, making everyday survival more engaging and rewarding. Highlights: - Discover new hobbies to pass the time and boost morale. - Play musical instruments, learn hundreds of songs, sing, form a band, and more. - Become the life of the party with functional jukeboxes, dj booths, disco balls and fully realized dance hobby with hundreds of dance moves. - Care for your survivor and turn your safehouse into a haven of cleanliness and tranquility with dozens of new interactible items and objects like mirrors, combs, bathtubs, showers, toothbrushes, sponges, perfumes, and more. - Perfect for players looking to personalize their experience or find new ways to engage with the game. Rediscover the joy of hobbies and self-expression, even in the harshest of times. Has sandbox options. Compatible with most other mods, except for mods that reduce the duration of timed actions.

mods.name: Simple Overhaul: Traits and Occupations (SOTO)
mods.description: B42.20 multiplayer-first overhaul of vanilla and custom traits and occupations, with server-authoritative progression, full localization, polished vanilla-style gameplay icons, and Faded branding.

mods.name: Faded Legendary Kit
mods.description: FadedLegendaryKit 1.0.3. Unified faded kit: packs, cap lamp, naginata, katana, wakizashi, and tactical weapons. Ultra-rare world loot. B42.20.3.

mods.name: Authentic Z
mods.description: SAFE TO ADD MID GAME

mods.name: Faded's Armor Pack
mods.description: Standalone Build 42.20 tactical armor collection with native night vision support, zombie outfits, and sandbox-controlled loot rarity.

mods.name: Faded Arsenal: Dead County Munitions
mods.description: Faded Arsenal 1.6.0 expands the complete 67-firearm arsenal with native quick reload, firearm handling and hearing, gun heat, casing presentation, an eight-position rifle sling, six-stage ammunition shelving, equipment fixtures, fire-selector input, ballistic impact effects, and enhanced server-authoritative ordnance. Native Build 42 remains authoritative for reload, inventory, throws, projectile physics, collision, and ordinary damage; existing magazines, attachments, suppressors, sounds, Gunsmith, racks, ammo crafting, and optional DeadCode integration remain intact.

mods.name: Whimsy Weapons
mods.description: Five fantastical melee weapons with custom models, textures, icons, and rare world spawns for Project Zomboid Build 42.20.

mods.name: Faded's Military Tool Kit Fix
mods.description: Build 42.20.2 compatibility and dependency release for Military Tool Kit by Papa_Chad. Maintained with permission by Faded; testing help by Ghost_Echo.

mods.name: Faded Trench Coats
mods.description: Version 1.0.1. A Build 42.20.2 port of the classic trench coat, rebuilt in the FadedTrenchCoats namespace. Includes closed and open variants, four period-appropriate colors, rare container loot, and an exceptionally rare detective zombie outfit.

mods.name: Spongie's Open Jackets
mods.description: Alternate wearable styles for vanilla clothing, updated for Build 42.20.2.

mods.name: Spongie's Clothing [B42 Port]
mods.description: Build 42.20 compatibility port of Spongie's Clothing (21.42.20.5). Fixes body-location hide-model overrides without Java reflection (no getDeclaredField crash on 42.20.2). Original mod by Spongie; port prepared by Faded with permission/request from the original developer.

mods.name: FFC
mods.description: Faded's Feastcraft: a Build 42.20.2 food command center with a three-pane kitchen, expiry-aware Auto Cook, safe heat monitoring, preservation, nutrition sorting, and MP-safe server validation.

mods.name: Faded Field Operations
mods.description: Mission and quest framework for Build 42.20. Version 1.2.3 polishes the Mission Board with stronger contrast, clearer title/status columns, scrollbar-safe gutters, responsive wrapped actions, repaginated briefings, and on-screen resizing and collapsed placement at small resolutions.

mods.name: Faded's Last Chance
mods.description: Server-authoritative Build 42.20 life-save charges with defibrillator self-revive.

mods.name: Faded Combat Text
mods.description: Build 42.20 combat text with optimized purple damage numbers and health bars that fade from green to yellow to red.

mods.name: Proximity Auto-Read
mods.description: Choose focused literature types or read every nearby unread knowledge item. Separates knowledge magazines from leisure magazines and uses Build 42.20 native read state and timed actions.

mods.name: It's A Trap!
mods.description: Build 42.20.4 only. Unified server-authoritative traps, animal/zombie trapping, private map markers, floor spikes, thrown ordnance, C4 breaching, remote/timed/proximity/impact explosives, vehicle bombs, destruction, industrial hazards, and repair systems. Includes optional shared command routing with automatic native fallback.

mods.name: The Path Less Traveled
mods.description: Build 42.20.2 native Skills-tab progression from level 10 to 15 with ClearView-style mastery cells and server-authoritative permanent category buffs.

mods.name: Faded Ninja
mods.description: Faded's Build 42.20 ninja survival arsenal: grappling hook traversal, throwing weapons, blades, clothing, fieldcraft literature, smoke bombs, firecrackers, and a rare themed sports car.

mods.name: Faded From The Window - Zombies Crash Through Windows
mods.description: Build 42.20 revival inspired by Zombies Crash Through Windows. Qualifying zombies smash and force their way through windows instead of opening them.

mods.name: Faded Beds Have Blankets
mods.description: Period-correct removable blankets, larger pillows, sleep warmth, and restful covered-bed sleep for Build 42.20.

mods.name: What A World
mods.description: Consent-first performance advisor plus a server-authoritative climate suite for Build 42.20.4. Version 1.2.1 permanently rebuilds AcidIrritationShiver as a self-contained animation node so it no longer depends on an unavailable vanilla XML parent. Low-FPS triage only recommends a profile or vanilla Display-settings review through the F7 Apply/Dismiss panel; it never selects a tier, changes display settings, applies emergency visuals, suppresses mod UI, or alters textures automatically. The optional FJL layer remains fully optional and gates engine-setting changes behind explicit in-game consent.

mods.name: What A World - Tree Visibility
mods.description: Optional TreeZ-derived companion shaders that keep foliage from hiding what is behind it. Published separately so servers and players can opt in deliberately.

mods.name: BuckShot Roulette
mods.description: A lethal, server-authoritative Buckshot Roulette simulation for one survivor against the Dealer or two nearby survivors. Requires at least one loaded revolver or shotgun to open the table. Includes the complete shell game, tactical items, custom Faded UI, prizes, and a one-use curative pill for PvP winners.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus
mods.description: Federated Access & Data Exchange for Dedicated Servers. Persistent authenticated multi-World connector, native verified content gate, full-width PZ workspace, and connector-authenticated automatic World-pack refresh after a verified FJL server sync.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // Survivor Pulse
mods.description: Private-by-default offline survivor dashboard for health, wounds, protection, body temperature, moodles, skills, equipment, loadout, encumbrance, nutrition extensions, and manifest-listed Faded mods. No Nexus connection or broadcast required.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // Nutrition Matrix
mods.description: Offline nutrition matrix for F.A.D.E.D Nexus Survivor Pulse. Tracks calories, carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, weight direction, and strength-training nutrition state without connecting or broadcasting.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // World Atlas
mods.description: Private-by-default offline second-screen world atlas with exploration fog, notes, custom-map baking, and vanilla-respecting multiplayer peer markers. No Nexus connection or broadcast required.

mods.name: Knox Phasmophobia
mods.description: Persistent server-authoritative paranormal investigations for Project Zomboid Build 42.20.4: 30 ghosts, seven evidence systems, 23 field items, native journal deduction, dispatch, visible hunts, furniture hiding, countermeasures, a cursed Ouija Board, and extensive sandbox controls. Self-contained with no traits, professions, occupations, Workshop dependencies, or Java loader.
